string.value: Careless driver
Passed baptism by fire
Member of the truck drivers union
Bribe taker
Every vagabond who has a truck with guns gets this perk.
Every fighter who has 100 kills gets this perk.
A trader who earned $100000 gets this perk.
The most accurate marksmen get this perk for two critical shots in the enemy's car in a row.
The driver who rode over 10 civilians gets this perk.
A man gets this perk for assaulting 5 trucks of friendly traders or vagabonds.
The perk is given to anyone who fails 5 tasks in city bars in a row.
The perk is given to the drivers who completed 5 tasks in city bars in a row.
Respectable citizens who help fight smuggling get this perk as a reward.
Those who have deals with bandits and smugglers get this perk.
[-1] - In your trophies after the destruction of enemy vehicles money will appear more frequently than goods.
[0] - You can get job in city bars.
[+1] - In your trophies after the destruction of enemy vehicles goods will appear more frequently than money.
[-3] - In the city repair shops you have an opportunity to buy device for weapon free of charge.
[0] - Less opportunity to stay without trophies after destruction of enemy vehicles.
[+3] - In the city repair shops you have an opportunity to buy device for vehicle free of charge.
[-2] - Choice of devices for weapon in city repair shops is always wider than devices for vehicle.
[0] - Stories about your ability and accuracy excited the hearts of village people.
[+2] - Choice of devices for vehicle in city repair shops is always wider than devices for weapon.
[0] - In the city repair shops you have an opportunity to buy goods free of charge.
[-3] - Weapon reload in city is cheaper. Vehicle fueling in the city is more expensive.
[0] - For the missions taken in city bars you get trade union bonus.
[+3] - Vehicle fueling in the city is cheaper. Weapon reload in city is more expensive.
[0] - In city shops list of goods for sale for you is limited.
[-2] - When you accidentally or specially ride down a wander man you'll find in his pocket a couple of coins.
[0] - Friendly truck drivers no more salute you by radio.
[-1] - In city bars for you the mission list is limited and you are offered only war missions.
[0] - Trade in city will bring you far more smaller profits.
[+1] - In city bars for you the mission list is limited and you are offered only trade missions.
[-2] - In city repair shops you purchase only contraband weapons that is why spend less money.
[0] - In city bars you are frequently offered missions of dingy nature.
[0] - Vehicle repair for you in the city is cheaper.
[+3] - In city and on fuel station you have opportunity to make repairs for free of charge.
